corrections.text: The headline, summary and the 'Where OpenAI's pages differ' section say the API reference says GIF output 'Requires access to the GIF preview for the selected model.' That sentence appears only in the reference's frame_count parameter entry; the output_format and frame_duration_ms entries do not repeat it. The guide, the two 2.6 model pages, the changelog entry and the launch post are silent on any preview or access requirement rather than stating a different one, so the pages 'differ' only in that one of them carries the sentence.
